verdict.rationale: Natural-language task planning and execution is a fair question for a robotics platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such capability. It covers only messaging primitives (topics, services, actions), CLI tools, security and QoS, which are building blocks rather than an NL-to-plan feature. The community remark that LLMs handle ROS boilerplate is a user-side workaround about writing code, not the platform planning tasks from natural language.
